method: Compiled comparison. The Snapdragon result was tested on the HONOR Magic8 (not in this database), the Dimensity on the vivo X300 Pro and the A19 Pro on the iPhone 17 Pro. The run method is not documented.

title: Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 vs Dimensity 9500 and Apple A19 Pro in efficiency analysis
author: Hannes Brecher
method: Power measurements by Geekerwan, as reported by Notebookcheck. CPU power at full load; GPU power during 3DMark Steel Nomad Light. Figures are approximate ('around') in the report.
summary: Geekerwan's measurements show the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 drawing about 19 W at full CPU load, against 12 W for the A19 Pro. On the GPU side it draws 1–3 W less than the Apple and MediaTek chips in Steel Nomad Light.

title: Galaxy S26 Ultra proves specs aren't everything as testing reveals cool thermals and 12% longer battery vs Galaxy S25 Ultra
author: Fawad Murtaza
method: Mrwhosetheboss side-by-side battery rundown (single pass, identical scripted routine) and thermal checks, as reported by Notebookcheck. Results are only comparable within this test.
summary: In Mrwhosetheboss's side-by-side rundown the Galaxy S26 Ultra lasted 12 hours, about 12% longer than the S25 Ultra, and ran coolest under extreme load.
